name: Herbert Hoover
desc: president of the United States from 1929 to 1933 (1874–1964)
summary: Herbert Clark Hoover (August 10, 1874 – October 20, 1964) was the 31st president of the United States from 1929 to 1933. A member of the Republican Party, his presidency was dominated by the Great Depression, and his ineffectual response to the growing economic crisis made him widely unpopular. He lost reelection to Democratic nominee Franklin D. Roosevelt in 1932.
